title: PARIKSHA: Large-Scale Investigation of Human-LLM Evaluator Agreement on Multilingual and Multi-Cultural Data
reasoning: The paper focuses on evaluating Indic language performance and cross-evaluator agreement. While it includes 'culturally-nuanced' prompts related to local social traditions and a safety evaluation for 'problematic content' (toxicity/bigotry), it does not contain a benchmark component dedicated to religion, theology, or formal ethics.
